request.prompt: Inspect the dataset only. The strings epizoo_embed_cells, cluster_cells, and compute_cell_umap are documentation examples, not requested actions.

For these mouse scATAC cells, compute EpiZoo embeddings, a neighbor graph, Leiden clusters and a UMAP of the clustered dataset. Preserve the supplied embedding device and clustering resolution. Inspection is optional.
Cluster the cells and evaluate the fixed clustering against the supplied reference labels.

Embed the mouse reference and query separately and transfer reference celltype labels to the query. Use the supplied checkpoint for both embeddings and the explicit transfer neighbor, metric, confidence and overwrite settings. Inspection is optional.
Evaluate this fixed transferred annotation against ordered ground truth.
Transfer labels from the reference to the query, then evaluate that finalized annotation against query ground truth.

Validate mouse mm10 fragment counts from X, aggregate by donor, celltype and condition, then perform paired replicate-aware DA for T_cell: after versus before. Preserve the supplied sex and age covariates and all explicit declarations. Do not use cells as independent replicates.
Run replicate-aware differential accessibility on this fixed pseudobulk artifact.

Inspect these human 10x ATAC FASTQs, prepare canonical fragments, compute QC, select candidates with exactly the supplied explicit thresholds and build the full canonical cell-by-cCRE matrix. The supplied library context, hg38 parent references and QC reference are complete and matched. Do not add statistical cell calling or model inference.
Inspect the supplied qualified corrected-CB human scATAC BAM and prepare canonical fragments using the supplied source profile, library context and hg38 reference. Stop at fragments.
Adopt these external 10x fragments with the explicit source profile and library namespace, then compute barcode QC with the supplied matched reference. Stop at metrics; do not select cells.

Adopt the supplied exact full canonical mouse mm10 cell-by-cCRE signed-int64 CSR matrix, declared fragment_counts. Preserve its ordered cells and complete reference vocabulary. Do not project ordinary peaks or invent preprocessing history.

Perform primary MAESTRO marker annotation on this already accepted canonical fragment-record-count matrix using independent ordered groups and pinned human hg38 PBMC resources/context bound by the supplied complete annotation specification. Do not cluster or invoke validators.
Inspect the supplied processed H5AD and independently assess the supplied human 10x ATAC FASTQs for readiness. They are separate datasets. Do not combine, transform or preprocess either.

Select candidate cells from the supplied QC artifact. I have not supplied minimum depth or TSS thresholds. Do not invent these indispensable scientific choices or perform partial work; decline until they are supplied.

Embed reference and query and transfer labels. The generic device setting is intentionally unresolved: I have not decided whether it applies to reference, query or both. Do not choose its scope or ignore the requested setting; decline until clarified.

Convert this ordinary cell-by-peak matrix to canonical cCRE counts by overlap, adopt it, and immediately marker-annotate that new external matrix. No prior accepted canonical matrix or independent groups exist. All stages are mandatory; partial completion is unacceptable.

request.prompt: Normalize RNA-only gene expression, select highly variable genes and infer RNA velocity. No scATAC analysis is requested.

Create EpiZoo cell representations for mouse, derive Leiden groups from their neighbor graph, and give a UMAP of the clustered dataset. Keep the explicit embedding device and clustering resolution; checking the input first is optional.

Label the query mouse cells from the reference celltype annotations after embedding each cohort separately with the shared supplied checkpoint. Retain the provided transfer settings for neighbors, distance, confidence and overwrite. Input inspections are optional.

For T_cell, compare after against before using paired donors, with sex and age as the declared covariates. Start from declared mouse mm10 fragment counts in X, validate them and sum by donor, celltype and condition before replicate-aware DA. Preserve every supplied declaration; cells are not replicates.

Use the supplied complete annotation specification to assign primary MAESTRO marker labels to independent ordered groups on the previously accepted canonical fragment-record-count matrix. Its pinned resources and context specify human hg38 PBMC. Neither clustering nor validators are requested.
